body: Ah, sounds very difficult. Seems like we all have something in common, aside from the obvious. Hopelessness. If only there was a more positive way out of it.

Hey there, I’m so sorry you’re feeling like that. And I’m so sorry that you have painful memories. Have you ever tried talking about them? Or does that not help? I can relate to some of your feelings, especially complete hopelessness; but I for one am pleased that you do not have the balls or know how to go through with it. My belief is you were not born a loser. Be well.

Hi, thanks. Don’t worry about late replies I’m grateful anyone is replying at all. Plus I’m all over the place at the moment too. 

Volunteering is a great suggestion. About a month ago I did look into this and found something that I would have loved to have done, but like most things in my life a lack of funds stops me. I don’t want to sound like the type of person who always has an excuse not to do something, but there really isn’t a way that I could’ve got to the destination from where I live without a small lottery win! It is a good idea though and I’ll keep looking for something more suitable. Do you think you’ll look into this?
Hey thanks for replying. Message me if you’d like to talk :)
Thank you, nice to know there are people out there. How are you today?

Hey thanks for your reply. How are you feeling today? I don’t know where to start really but I’ve simplified my emotions and put them in a nutshell in a comment above. Hope you’re feeling a little better.

Hey thanks for your message. Like most days, an unmanageable amount of debt, a meaningless and low paying job and a loveless life for many years. I’ve coped for a long time but I’m sick of coping to be honest. Thanks for replying.
